name: open_genes

relevance.justification: Directly aligned with the gene entity type: curated per-gene records with NCBI/Entrez, Ensembl, UniProt cross-references, ICD-10/ICD-11 disease links, and functional/pathway annotations (aging mechanisms, GO-like protein classes). Confirmed live via the API which returns fully structured, tabular gene records (not free text).

novelty.justification: Curates aging/longevity biology (lifespan-extension experiments across model organisms, aging mechanisms, functional clusters, confidence-tiered gene-aging associations, disease links via ICD) that is not present in MyGene.info, MyDisease.info, or any existing/pending BioThings API. The only tangential overlap is Wellderly (healthy-aging variant frequencies in existing-biothings-plugins.json), which is variant-level population genomics, not gene-aging-mechanism curation — no meaningful overlap. Neither 'open genes' nor 'aging'/'genage' sources appear in existing-biothings-plugins.json or pending-api-datasources.json.

openness.justification: Paper states CC-BY license for the data and MPL-2.0 for the codebase (GitHub open-genes/open-genes-api). Live REST API confirmed publicly queryable with no auth/key (verified with a direct curl call returning full JSON records). MySQL dump and TSV downloads also offered per the paper and GitHub README. Scored 4/5 rather than 5 because the CC-BY license/version text could not be independently re-confirmed on the live site (open-genes.com is JS-rendered and returned no license text directly), and the exact SQL dump direct-download URL could not be verified live (only referenced in GitHub docs as open_genes_sql_dump.zip).

evidence.scope: Curated database of human genes associated with aging and longevity: 2,402-2,405 genes, ~1,975 lifespan-experiment records (model organism gene modulation vs. lifespan), ~4,644 age-related-change records, ~1,458 longevity-association records across 362 genes, plus disease links (ICD-10/ICD-11), aging mechanisms, functional clusters, protein classes, and genomic location/transcript/exon data.
evidence.overlap: Minor conceptual overlap with Wellderly (healthy aging, population variant frequencies) but no field-level or entity-level redundancy — Wellderly is variant-level, Open Genes is gene/mechanism-level curation of aging biology.

license.name: CC-BY (data, per paper) / MPL-2.0 (code, per GitHub repo)
restrictions: Attribution required for CC-BY data reuse; exact CC-BY version (4.0 assumed) not independently re-confirmed on live site.

api_info.rate_limits: unknown (not documented, not encountered during a single test query)
api_info.pagination: page/pageSize (default pageSize=20; 121 pages observed for 2405 records)
api_info.record_coverage: full — verified live query returned complete nested per-gene record (cross-refs, diseases, aging mechanisms, transcripts/exons)

risks: Homepage and /download page are JS-rendered SPA shells — direct download file URLs and on-site license text could not be confirmed via WebFetch; relied on paper (PMC10768108) and GitHub repo docs instead.
Exact CC-BY version number not independently confirmed on the live site.
Rate limits and API stability under bulk crawl (2,405 records / 121 pages) not stress-tested.
next_actions: Proceed to Phase 3 deep inspection (completed in this pass)
Proceed to plugin generation targeting pending.api as an API-crawl-based new BioThings API
